mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances despite a rising FEDFUNDS trend (Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening, triggering immediate equity market sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in employment growth signals a tight labor market, which fuels inflation and prompts monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The combination of UNRATE decline and PAYEMS rise fails to produce negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion marked by high housing starts and robust consumer spending, the S&P 500 typically underperforms due to overvaluation and recession risks, yielding negative returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1200 and RSAFS > 450000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production indicates economic weakness, reducing corporate earnings prospects and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not correlate with negative 20-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 6.0% (CPIAUCSL > 6.0%) triggers fears of aggressive monetary policy, causing immediate equity market declines and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and consumer spending signals overheating demand, which leads to inflationary pressures and subsequent monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of HOUST and RSAFS rising fails to produce negative 60-day returns in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month), inflationary pressures mount, prompting rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 4.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.
